lines.text: You know the man with the mole.
Last night, police picked up four of him.
Only one is him, and you've seen all his crimes.
Whoever you pick goes on every screen in the city tonight.
Because if it's the wrong man, that's an innocent man's face, everywhere he goes.
And the real one walks right past it.
It was in every photo you saw.
lines.text_kokoro: It was in every [photo](/fˈOtO/) you saw.

lines.text: Memory keeps the mole, and drops the side.
Did you know it, or did you guess?
Did you know it, or did you guess it?

ref_text: Have you seen this man? Police say he was last seen near the market, and they are asking anyone who knows him to call.
